categories.title: Water / Beverage Cap Mould
categories.description: High-precision tooling for mineral water, carbonated drinks and juice closures.
categories.short: Water and beverage closure tooling for high-volume packaging projects.
categories.detail: A dedicated starting point for water and beverage closures. Drawing, neck finish, resin, cavities, cooling and machine interface are confirmed during project review.
checks: Product drawing and closure geometry review
Target resin, shrinkage and sealing assumptions
Cavity plan, cycle goal and machine interface
Trial samples, inspection points and handover evidence

categories.title: Edible Oil Cap Mould
categories.description: Pull-ring and tamper-evident solutions for olive, sunflower and cooking oils.
categories.short: Pull-ring and tamper-evident oil closure tooling.
categories.detail: Oil closure projects are reviewed around the pourer, pull-ring or tamper-evident geometry, target resin, sealing points and the buyer's production machine.
checks: Cavity balance, ejection and inspection plan

categories.title: Engine Oil Cap Mould
categories.description: Heavy-duty closures for automotive lubricant containers and industrial packaging.
categories.short: Heavy-duty tooling for lubricant and industrial closures.
categories.detail: Engine-oil closure work starts from the bottle and cap drawing, pouring feature, chemical-use requirements, resin and machine interface.

categories.title: Food Packaging Cap Mould
categories.description: Food-grade screw and snap-on tooling for sauces, dairy and dry food containers.
categories.short: Screw and snap-on tooling for food packaging closures.
categories.detail: Food packaging projects are checked against the closure drawing, seal, gate, resin, food-contact documentation and production target.

categories.title: Medical Cap Mould
categories.description: Precision closures for pharmaceutical bottles, syrups and diagnostic packaging.
categories.short: Controlled tooling direction for pharmaceutical and diagnostic closures.
categories.detail: Medical closure requests are reviewed around the approved drawing, functional mechanism, resin, cleanliness expectations and inspection evidence.

categories.title: Cosmetic Cap Mould (Flip-Top)
categories.description: Living-hinge tooling for shampoo, conditioner and skincare packaging.
categories.short: Living-hinge tooling for flip-top cosmetic packaging.
categories.detail: Flip-top projects are reviewed around hinge travel, snap fit, orifice, surface finish, resin and the required opening-cycle target supplied by the buyer.
checks: Hinge, snap fit and orifice geometry

categories.title: Personal Care Cap Mould
categories.description: Disc-top, tube-cap and lotion closure tooling with custom orifice options.
categories.short: Disc-top, tube-cap and lotion closure tooling.
categories.detail: Personal-care closure projects are matched to the package drawing, dispensing feature, finish, resin, sealing requirements and production target.

categories.title: Functional Cap Mould (Combination)
categories.description: Child-resistant, easy-open and tamper-evident mechanisms in one closure family.
categories.short: Combination closure tooling for functional mechanisms.
categories.detail: Functional closures are reviewed around the mechanism, user interaction, assembly, resin, tamper evidence and the test evidence required by the buyer.

categories.title: Handle Mould
categories.description: Ergonomic handles for 5L–20L PET bottles, oil containers and chemical jerry cans.
categories.short: High-load handle tooling for large containers and jerry cans.
categories.detail: Handle projects start from the bottle interface, load target, grip geometry, resin, assembly method and the production machine information.

services.title: Mould Design & Engineering
services.text: Review drawings, parting lines, cooling, ejection and the production machine interface before tooling is approved.

services.title: Precision Manufacturing
services.text: Coordinate machining, EDM, fitting and assembly against the approved tooling brief and inspection checkpoints.

services.title: Trial, Sampling & Optimisation
services.text: Plan trial shots, sample feedback, dimensional checks and controlled changes before production handover.
